answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 13 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 900 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. Graded work is the only ladder, and each rung takes a full epoch. The raven test is the live device, the nadir test is the locked stake, and the atlas test is the graded history no template can fake. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
